title: Scenic Flight to Lukla
desc: The adventure begins with a memorable flight to Lukla (2,840–2,860 m), offering views of rolling hills, deep valleys, and dramatic Himalayan terrain when weather permits.

title: Trek Along the Dudh Koshi River
desc: Follow the glacial river through pine forests, terraced fields, and stone hamlets. The sound of rushing waters accompanies your first steps into the Khumbu.

title: Suspension Bridges and Mountain Trails
desc: Cross iconic suspension bridges draped with colorful Tibetan prayer flags high above river gorges, including the renowned Hillary Bridge leading into Namche.

title: Enter Sagarmatha National Park
desc: Pass through the UNESCO World Heritage checkpoint at Monjo. The national park protects alpine forests, musk deer, snow leopards, and the world's highest peaks.

title: Namche Bazaar, the Heart of the Khumbu
desc: Nestled in a horseshoe-shaped mountainside at 3,440 m, Namche is the trading hub of the region, featuring artisanal bakeries, gear shops, cafés, and local museums.

title: Acclimatization in Namche Bazaar
desc: A dedicated rest and adjustment day allows your body to adapt naturally to 3,440 m, supported by gentle scenic walks, hydration, and guidance from our certified staff.

title: Panoramic Views from Hotel Everest View
desc: Perched at approximately 3,880 m on an elevated ridge, the hotel terrace offers an awe-inspiring 360-degree amphitheater of peaks without trekking to Base Camp.

title: Views of Mount Everest and Himalayan Giants
desc: Gaze upon Mount Everest (8,848.86 m), Lhotse (8,516 m), Nuptse, the sharply sculpted pyramid of Ama Dablam (6,812 m), and the twin peaks of Thamserku.

title: Traditional Villages of Khumjung & Khunde
desc: Explore high green-roofed stone villages at ~3,790 m and ~3,840 m. Visit the Hillary School, Khumjung Monastery, and observe peaceful agrarian mountain living.

title: Buddhist Culture and Himalayan Traditions
desc: Walk clockwise past sacred carved mani walls, ancient stone chortens, and spinning prayer wheels that embody centuries of Tibetan Buddhist devotion.

title: Changing Landscapes from Lukla to Namche
desc: Experience dynamic environmental shifts from sheltered river valleys with rhododendrons and pines to steep rocky staircases and dramatic high-altitude alpine ridges.

title: Traditional Teahouse Accommodation
desc: Enjoy authentic Sherpa hospitality in cozy mountain teahouses, sharing stories around heated dining room woodstoves and resting comfortably in twin-sharing rooms.

title: Experience Local Food and Hospitality
desc: Fuel your trek with fresh, unlimited Nepali Dal Bhat (rice, lentil soup, vegetables), steaming momos, garlic soups, Sherpa stews, and warming ginger lemon honey teas.

title: Photography Opportunities Throughout the Trek
desc: Capture morning light on Ama Dablam, vibrant prayer flags fluttering on bridges, terraced villages, and the iconic pyramid of Everest framed by pine forests.

title: A Short Trek with a Rewarding Experience
desc: In just seven days, achieve a genuine high-altitude Himalayan journey combining big mountain views, authentic culture, and a safe, moderate walking schedule.

title: Responsible Ecotourism & Sagarmatha Conservation
desc: We practice Leave No Trace principles, support local village economies, ensure fair wages and insurance for porters, and protect the fragile Khumbu ecosystem.
